The '''''Elorac''''' was a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] that was used by a civilian company. The ship was inspected by a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] to find [[Amber]] as its manifest had claimed and therefore was free to leave.
